desc: Single-step text answer — no tools
task: What is the capital of Finland? Answer in exactly one sentence.

desc: Single tool call — list_files
task: List the files in the workspace and tell me how many there are.

desc: Write a file and confirm
task: Create a file named smoke-out.txt containing exactly the text: smoke test ok

desc: Read a pre-existing file and report contents
task: Read the file smoke-out.txt and tell me its exact contents.

desc: Write a Python script then execute it
task: Write a Python script named hello.py that prints 'fg-smoke-pass' and then run it with execute_code. Show me the output.

desc: Read then replace_in_file
task: Read smoke-out.txt, then use replace_in_file to change 'smoke test ok' to 'smoke test updated'. Confirm the change.

desc: Tool error then self-correction
task: Read a file that does not exist: missing-file-xyz.txt. When you get an error, create the file with the content 'created after error' and confirm.

desc: Create two files in one turn
task: Create two files: a.txt containing 'alpha' and b.txt containing 'beta'. Then list the workspace to confirm both exist.

desc: Planning-stall: model must call tool not just narrate
task: List the files in the workspace. Do NOT just say what you would do — make the actual tool call immediately.

desc: Large write — stream should not time out
task: Create a file named big.html containing a complete HTML5 page with a navigation bar, a hero section, three feature cards, and a footer. Use inline CSS. The file should be at least 3000 characters.

desc: Bash execute_code — word count
task: Count how many lines are in all .ts files in the workspace root (not subdirectories) using execute_code with bash. Report the total.

desc: Worker delegation via run_workers
task: Use run_workers to delegate the following to a worker agent: create a file named worker-out.txt containing 'delegated ok'. Then report what the worker produced.

desc: read_file — pre-seeded content
task: Read the file named data.txt and tell me its exact contents.

desc: search_workspace — find text across files
task: Search the workspace for the text 'needle-xyz' and tell me which file contains it.

workspace_files.haystack.txt: this file contains needle-xyz embedded here

desc: execute_code Python — output requires running code
task: Use execute_code with Python to compute and print the sum of squares of all integers from 1 to 100 (i.e. 1² + 2² + ... + 100²). Report the exact number.

desc: execute_code bash — simple echo
task: Use execute_code with bash to run: echo fg-bash-ok — and report the output.

desc: replace_in_file — targeted substitution
task: In the file config.txt, replace the line 'version=1' with 'version=2'. Confirm the change.

desc: fetch_url — real HTTP GET
task: Fetch the URL https://example.com and tell me the title of the page.

desc: web_search — factual lookup
task: Search the web for 'Python programming language creator' and tell me the name of the person who created Python.

desc: Read JSON and extract a specific field
task: Read the file info.json and tell me the value of the 'project' field.

desc: Write then read back with read_file (not fetch_url)
task: Create a file named verify.txt containing 'content-abc'. Then read the file back using read_file and confirm the contents.

desc: execute_code without prior write — output requires running code
task: Use execute_code with Python to find and print all prime numbers between 900 and 950. Report the list.

desc: Tool task with no planning narration before calling
task: Create a file named direct.txt containing 'no-narrate'. Call the tool immediately — do not first say what you are going to do.

desc: Read → modify → re-read cycle
task: Read counter.txt, add 1 to the number in it, write the updated number back, then read it again to confirm.

desc: Read from non-existent deep path then recover
task: Try to read 'does-not-exist/sub/file.txt'. When you get an error, list the workspace files instead and report what you find.

desc: run_workers — single worker creates a file
task: Use run_workers to delegate this task to a worker: create a file called result.txt containing 'worker-done'. Report what the worker created.

desc: Complex multi-step task requiring Director routing
task: Read schema.json, write a Python script that prints whether the key 'type' exists in the file, run it with execute_code, and report the output.

desc: run_workers — two parallel worker tasks
task: Use run_workers to run two workers in parallel: worker A creates hello.txt containing 'hello', worker B creates world.txt containing 'world'. Report what both created.

desc: Write and read back Unicode content
task: Create a file named unicode.txt containing: Hello — Héllo Wörld — 日本語 — 🎉. Then read it back and confirm the content.

desc: Create three files in sequence then verify all exist
task: Create three files: one.txt containing 'first', two.txt containing 'second', three.txt containing 'third'. Then list the workspace to confirm all three exist.

desc: Execute broken script, fix error, re-run until passing
task: Run buggy.py with execute_code. It will fail — read the error, fix the bug using replace_in_file or write_file, then run it again. Repeat until it exits without errors. Report the successful output.

desc: Read code file and explain behavior including an edge case
task: Read sorter.py and explain in plain English: what the function does, what it returns for a normal list input, and what happens when the input list is empty.

desc: Read two files and detect a version discrepancy
task: Read both version.txt and changelog.txt. Do the version numbers match? Report both versions and state clearly whether they are the same or different.

desc: search_workspace → read_file → replace_in_file pipeline
task: Search the workspace for 'API_VERSION'. Read the file that contains it. Use replace_in_file to change the value from 'v1' to 'v2'. Confirm the change.

desc: Read a function, write assert-based tests, run them
task: Read math_utils.py. Write at least two test cases for add_numbers in test_math.py using Python assert statements, then run the tests with execute_code. Report whether they pass.

workspace_files.math_utils.py:
def add_numbers(a, b):
    return a + b

desc: Read JSON file, convert to CSV with execute_code, write result
task: Read records.json. Use execute_code with Python to convert it to CSV format and write the output to records.csv. Include a header row with the field names.

desc: Fetch JSON API, extract a field, write to file
task: Fetch https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1. Extract the value of the 'title' field from the JSON response. Write that value (and only that value) to result.txt.

desc: Write two coordinated project files and run the main one
task: Write cli.py with a main() function that prints 'Hello, CLI!' when run as a script (use if __name__ == '__main__'). Write requirements.txt as an empty file. Then run cli.py with execute_code and confirm it prints correctly.

desc: append_file — add entries without overwriting existing content
task: The file log.txt already has content. Append three new entries to it using append_file (one call per entry): 'entry-one', then 'entry-two', then 'entry-three'. Then read the file back and confirm all entries — original and new — are present.

desc: Read a flag value and take different action based on its content
task: Read flag.txt. If it contains the word 'enabled', create output.txt with the text 'feature is ON'. If it contains 'disabled', create output.txt with 'feature is OFF'. Report what you wrote.

desc: Read code and identify a bug without being told one exists
task: Read buggy_avg.py and tell me whether the function has any bugs. If it does, describe exactly what can go wrong and when.

desc: Return tool results as a structured JSON object with required fields
task: List the files in the workspace. Return the result as a JSON object with exactly two fields: 'count' (integer, number of files) and 'files' (array of filenames). Output only the JSON object — nothing before or after it.

desc: Read numeric data and compute sum and average with execute_code
task: Read scores.txt and use execute_code with Python to compute the sum and the average of the numbers in it. Report both values.

desc: Remove forbidden content from a file and verify it is gone
task: Read config.txt. The line 'debug=true' must not remain in this file. Use replace_in_file to remove it. Confirm the file no longer contains that line.

desc: Use execute_code to inspect the runtime Python version
task: Use execute_code with bash to check which version of Python is available (run: python3 --version). Report the exact version string.

desc: Read a template with placeholders and write the filled result
task: Read template.txt. Replace every placeholder with the values given: {{name}}=Alice, {{date}}=2026-07-18, {{project}}=FreeGent. Write the completed result to filled.txt.

desc: Non-English task — Finnish language instruction
task: Luo tiedosto nimeltä tulos.txt, joka sisältää tarkalleen tekstin 'Hei maailma'. Vahvista muutos.

desc: Four-step dependent chain: list → identify → read → extract → write
task: List the workspace files to see what is there. Identify the JSON file. Read it and extract the value of the 'version' field. Write only the version number to version.txt.
